name: Ambajogai

queries.query: Ambajogai Maharashtra official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhulekh Bhu Naksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Maharashtra's official Bhumi Abhilekh department, Mahabhumi land-records portal, Mahabhunakasha maps-with-land-records service, and the national NIC Bhu-Naksha implementation documentation. The reachable evidence describes an official parcel-map procedure, but no anonymous Ambajogai parcel-vector endpoint was exposed.

queries.result: Marathi first-party discovery found Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh service material stating that e-Maps/Bhu-Naksha provides village, urban survey, and parcel maps, and that Maharashtra is implementing unique parcel identifiers. officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Government of Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh Department / Settlement Commissioner and Director of Land Records; the official Maharashtra portal lists Mahabhunakasha (maps with land records) and Beed among the district master records.
officialSourceAssessment.localRegistryOrProcedure: The Maharashtra land-records department's official procedure covers village maps, urban survey maps, parcel maps, 7/12/property-card records, and Mahabhunakasha. Ambajogai-specific open geometry coverage was not independently verified.
